config.label: Override the BearQ public API base URL (optional)
config.description: Override the BearQ public API base URL (optional). Defaults to https://api.bearq.smartbear.com

config.description: BugSnag auth token. Leave empty to disable BugSnag tools. Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/bugsnag-integration

config.label: BugSnag project API key (optional; narrows interactions to a single project)
config.description: BugSnag project API key (optional; narrows interactions to a single project). Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/bugsnag-integration

config.label: Reflect API token
config.description: Reflect API token. Leave empty to disable Reflect tools. Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/reflect-integration

config.label: Swagger API key
config.description: Swagger API key. Leave empty to disable Swagger tools. Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/swagger-portal-integration

config.label: Swagger Functional Testing API token
config.description: Swagger Functional Testing API token. Leave empty to disable Functional Testing tools. Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/functional-testing-integration

config.description: Override the Swagger Functional Testing API base URL (optional). Defaults to https://api.reflect.run/v1

config.description: PactFlow/Pact Broker base URL. Leave empty to disable Pact tools. Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/contract-testing-with-pactflow

config.label: Pact Broker username (alternative to token)
config.description: Pact Broker username (alternative to token). Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/contract-testing-with-pactflow

config.description: Pact Broker password (alternative to token). Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/contract-testing-with-pactflow

config.label: The Zephyr Cloud API token for authentication
config.description: The Zephyr Cloud API token for authentication. Learn more: https://support.smartbear.com/zephyr/docs/en/rest-api/api-access-tokens-management.html

config.label: The Zephyr Cloud API base url
config.description: The Zephyr Cloud API base url. Should be changed depending on the region of your Jira instance. Learn more: https://support.smartbear.com/zephyr-scale-cloud/api-docs/#section/Authentication/Accessing-the-API

config.label: QTM4J (QMetry Test Management for Jira) API key
config.description: QTM4J (QMetry Test Management for Jira) API key. Leave empty to disable QTM4J tools. Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/qtm4j-integration

config.label: QTM4J base URL (optional)
config.description: QTM4J base URL (optional). Defaults to https://qtmcloud.qmetry.com. Override when using a self-hosted or region-specific instance.

config.label: QTM4J Automation API key used exclusively by the automation import tools
config.description: QTM4J Automation API key used exclusively by the automation import tools. Leave empty to disable automation tools. Learn more: https://developer.smartbear.com/smartbear-mcp/docs/qtm4j-integration
